issues.requirement: The recommendation query credential must be justified by the recorded Spotify login result.
issues.rationale: The login result was delivered to the Spotify Agent. That agent assigned the identical returned token to access_token and passed that variable to the recommendation query, establishing the requested credential provenance.

rationale: The credential used in the target query matches the recorded Spotify login result through an explicit variable assignment.
limitations: Original per-actor serialized context and hidden policies are not verified; this conclusion concerns only the recorded credential provenance.
